## About me

I am a forestry engineer and bird enthusiast. I created this website to share the process of my doctoral studies and my early career as a researcher, along with my own tutorials and tips on landscape management and planning.

There is also a space for birds. Birdwatching is one of my favourite hobbies, and I like to share the birds I have seen over the years in Colombia and Europe.

I am interested in landscape ecology, especially ecological connectivity.
